subject.title: fix(codex): keep progress replies from ending active turns

question: Should Codex `message_tool_only` completion permanently require explicit `final=true`, or should OpenClaw preserve implicit confirmed-delivery completion and use prompt steering only?
rationale: Both approaches address the reproduced bug, but they create different long-term completion and compatibility contracts that code review cannot choose safely.

options.title: Prompt-only mitigation
